source_evidence: Write down what you and others in your family earn and spend each month, and include a category for savings and investing.
answer: To make a simple budget, record the income your household receives and the expenses it pays each month. Include savings and investing as their own category so you can see whether money is being set aside. Review where your money goes: if all your income is being spent, the source suggests starting by cutting back on expenses. Tracking everyday spending can help you notice how smaller costs add up.
